functionality.rationale: Final P1 reliability evidence must exercise production multi-file, collision, failure, recovery, and cleanup rather than isolated components.

security.rationale: Adverse tests must preserve authenticated identity, containment, existing files, and fail-closed cleanup under hostile inputs and races.

performance.rationale: Large sparse files, constrained storage, delayed I/O, and long matrices must remain bounded and deterministic in CI.

compatibility.rationale: The interoperability matrix must cover supported macOS, Windows, and Linux sender and receiver roles.

concurrency.rationale: Sleep, wake, interface churn, process kill, reconnect, cancellation, destination races, and child teardown are concurrency release gates.

platform.rationale: Platform-specific filesystems, sleep, network interfaces, process control, and packaging must all produce explicit evidence.

persistence.rationale: Low space, restart, resume, collision, process kill, and cleanup must not corrupt committed files or retain stale checkpoints.

adr.rationale: The task produces executable evidence against accepted product, security, and persistence decisions.

architecture.rationale: Only packaged-application tests and CI infrastructure change.

roadmap.rationale: XT-039 alone evaluates this evidence and closes the P1 production roadmap.
